spells/interfaith-blessing-609.name: Interfaith Blessing
spells/interfaith-blessing-609.effectSummary: Every creature within the 20-foot-radius burst receives a blessing from its own deity for 1 minute per caster level. If a subject venerates more than one deity, determine the blessing randomly. Bahamut, St. Cuthbert, or Yondalla grant +1 on attack rolls and saves; Boccob, Corellon Larethian, Vecna, or Wee Jas grant +1 on attack rolls and skill checks; Ehlonna, Obad-Hai, or general nature worship grants +1 on attack rolls and AC; Erythnul, Gruumsh, or Lolth grant +2 on damage rolls; Fharlanghn, Moradin, or Pelor grant +2 AC; Garl Glittergold, Olidammara, or no deity require a 1d8 roll to determine the blessing, with a result of 6 chosen by the player; Heironeous, Hextor, or Nerull grant +2 on attack rolls; Kord, Kurtulmak, or Tiamat grant +1 on attack and damage rolls. The bonus is sacred for a good or neutral worshipped deity and profane for an evil one.

spells/know-greatest-enemy-4331.name: Know Greatest Enemy
spells/know-greatest-enemy-4331.effectSummary: While you concentrate, evaluates creatures in the 60-foot cone by Challenge Rating: CR 4 or lower is Weak, CR 5–10 Moderate, CR 11–15 Strong, and CR 16 or higher Overwhelming. Within each category you know which creature is the most powerful, but not why it is stronger. A spell of 3rd level or higher that prevents scrying on a creature or area, such as nondetection or false vision, prevents this spell from evaluating that protected creature or creatures in that protected area.

spells/prespers-moonbow-2260.name: Presper's Moonbow
spells/prespers-moonbow-2260.effectSummary: Conjures 1d4 motes of electricity. You can immediately fire any number of them at targets within range, assigning multiple motes to one target or splitting them among targets; each mote requires its own ranged touch attack. Damage per mote depends on the total number created: 1 mote deals 4d6, 2 motes deal 3d6 each, 3 motes deal 2d6 each, and 4 motes deal 2d4 each. If you do not fire all motes immediately, you can fire remaining motes as a standard action on the next round; if a round passes in which you fire no mote, the spell ends and all remaining motes vanish. The material component is a small piece of moonstone.

spells/standing-wave-4227.name: Standing Wave
spells/standing-wave-4227.effectSummary: Raises a wave under one creature or object within range and carries it in a straight line over water at 60 feet per round. An affected object can carry creatures or other objects. Maximum size depends on caster level: 5th Medium, 7th Large, 9th Huge, 11th Gargantuan, 13th Colossal. The wave dissipates on contacting land and lowers its burden harmlessly ashore. If you are riding in or standing on the affected object, it keeps moving until you leave it or dismiss the spell; otherwise it moves only to the extent of the spell's range from where you cast it.
spells/standing-wave-4227.notes: Source-locked to Spell Compendium p.204. Its added rider/standing-on-object continuation rule is preserved and is not backported to the earlier Complete Divine printing.
